Co-developed with leading oncology teams for the NHS, private healthcare and insurance providers.

Our clinically validated, AI powered digital tools enable more proactive, personalised cancer care - inside and outside clinical settings. Seamless, secure and simple to use, Careology supports everyone involved in the cancer care journey.

Designed and built based from first hand experience of dealing with the Up Days and the Down Days of cancer, Careology combines clinical and holistic support with engaging, AI powered digital tools, to support people living with cancer. By keeping them connected to their healthcare teams, friends and family we enhance the patient experience, and offer significant benefits to healthcare providers and payers.
